spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अर्जति)
To earn, to gain or acquire, (commonly used with उप prefixed.)
10th cl. (अर्जयति)
1 The same, and:
2 To work or manufacture.
3 To make or prepare. This root and its derivatives are also read अर्ज्ज, &c. doubling the consonant after र.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
An acquirer, one who gains or acquires.
m. (-कः)
Basil, the white sort, (Ocymum villosum.)
E.
अर्ज to gain, and वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Gain, acquisition of wealth, &c.
E.
अर्ज, and ल्युट् affix, also written अर्ज्जन.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gained, acquired.
E.
अर्ज to gain, क्त affix, also written अर्ज्जित.

m. (-नः)
1 The third of the Pāṇḍavas, the son of INDRA and friend of KṚṢṆ

The name of a king with a thousand arms. See कार्त्तवीर्य्य.
3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
4 A peacock.
5 The only son of his mother.
6 White, (the colour.)
nf. (-नं-नी)
1

Grass.
2

Slight inflammation of the conjunctiva or white of the eye.
f. (-नी)
1 A cow.
2 UṢĀ, the wife of

ANIRUDDHA.
3
The Karatoya river in the north of

Bengal.
4

A procuress, a bawd.
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
White.
E.
अर्ज to gain, उनन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीप्^1, also read अर्ज्जुन.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: missing virAma.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Belonging to ARJUNA.
E.
अर्जुन and वुन् aff.

ind.
On the side or party of ARJUNA.
E.
अर्जुन and तसि aff.

mfn. (-विः-विः-वि)
White, of a white colour.
E.
अर्जुन white, and छवि light.

m. (-जः)
The monkey HANUMĀN.
E.
अर्जुन, and ध्वज a banner, being ARJUNA'S symbol.

m. (-मः)
The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.)
E.
अर्जुन a tree, &c. उपम like.

Straightness.
2

Rectitude, propriety of act or observance.
3 Sincerity.
E.
ऋञ् straight, अण् aff.
